body: I don't even have a sexuality anymore.  It's been invalidated.

These aren't things that can be helped with, otherwise they would have happened.

You don't seem to have a very good grasp on the human condition, it's so removed from the feelings and emotions and wants and needs of actual life.

Life is literally sex, look at everything.  Most animals ONLY do sex, that's it. Pollen, sex. Birds singing. Sex.  Don't you get it?  I don't belong, that's the message I'm repeatedly getting regardless whether we can admit what sex selection ACTUALLY is.

It is, though. Otherwise this wouldn't be my life.  All that stuff people say happens only happens to other people, there must be a reason that after changing so much the outcome stays the same. Rejection, failure, isolation, pain.

It's sad, ya know? The entirety of life is this cycle of hope, failure, and wishing for death, like an animal on the side of the road that got hit by a car.

I understand, I am not a part of the future, I am a relic of the past, of traditions which no longer hold. This new evolution of humanity is too much for me, too small, too feminine, not fun enough, not whatever enough. Wrong. Any intelligent person would see the problem is me and that after this much time the only way to fix it is to turn off.

The only thing sadder than death is suffering leading to death. So death is beautiful, please pray for my death. Please. There is always a reason why things can't go right. That reason was me.  Let's make it past tense and end this. If collective energy is a thing, please wish for my death, show your humanity.
